subject: Micro-sprint fund request to preserve demo access
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novamed.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 15 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Micro-sprint fund request to preserve demo access

Hi Priya —

Quick note after our call this morning: I understand procurement is queued for ~2 weeks and you’re worried the pilot will time out before budget approval lands. To keep your engineers running and the proof-of-concept moving, we can offer a short, one-time micro-sponsorship voucher that will preserve the sandbox and give your team ~75k tokens (roughly 7 days of normal test traffic).

Proposal summary:
- Voucher: 75,000 token credit applied to Novamed sandbox
- Duration: 7 days of grace starting when we activate
- Conditions: acceptance email from an authorized Novamed approver (no PO required up front); we’ll invoice afterward or convert to PO once procurement has a number

If that sounds good, reply with the best contact to accept on behalf of procurement (or a PO number if available) and I’ll send the voucher + DocuSign acceptance. I attached the short terms for transparency.

Thanks — want to keep momentum and demo access here.

— Camila
Camila Reyes | Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Attachment: novamed-micro-sponsorship-terms.pdf (pdf, 12KB)

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novamed.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Novamed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Dec 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Micro-sprint fund request to preserve demo access

Hi Camila —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the offer. Procurement is swamped with quarter-end audits; realistically they’ll only process POs in about 10–14 business days. Two quick questions: 1) can Novamed accept the voucher via an acceptance email (procurement can then invoice) or does Redwood require a signed DocuSign for credits? 2) If we accept, what would you list as the invoice line and billing contact so procurement can fast-track it when they reopen the queue?

If it helps, route acceptance to procurement@novamed.com and use "Demo Sponsorship — Dec 2027" as the invoice description. I can escalate internally but need something simple to hand procurement so it doesn’t block their queue.

— Priya
Priya Shah | Sr. Product Manager, Novamed

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Dec 2027 13:20:00 -0800
Subject: internal: quick approval request — Novamed micro-voucher (RED-7832)

Markus / Lauren / Steph —

Novamed’s procurement queue is blocked and the pilot timer is counting down. Priya (prod) asked for a simple acceptance path or voucher so the demo doesn’t lose momentum. Recommendation: approve a 75k-token voucher for a 7-day preservation window, with post-event invoicing (invoice line: "Demo Sponsorship — Dec 2027"). No discount beyond the credit itself; we’ll preserve MRV and not convert to a longer-term discount.

Why: high-fit AE-led proof-of-concept, championed by Priya; sales motion shows clear PoC -> pilot -> paid path, ARR upside if we keep the engagement warm.

If approved, I’ll send the acceptance options to Priya and copy procurement@novamed.com. I’ve attached the short terms. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/RED-7832.

Requesting either: a one-line approval in this thread or a sign-off from finance to issue voucher RED-7832.

— Camila

From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Dec 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: internal: quick approval request — Novamed micro-voucher (RED-7832)

Thanks Camila — sounds reasonable to me. Approve the 75k token voucher for 7 days. Finance/legal: lightweight terms only (attached PDF) — I expect no long-term change to pricing. Camila, please send the acceptance template to Priya and include the invoice contact line she suggested. If procurement later issues a PO, we can update billing.

Markus
Head of Sales, West — Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>

Hi Priya — thanks for confirming details. Per internal approval, we’ll activate the voucher once we have an authorized acceptance from Novamed. Two options below; choose what your procurement team prefers: 

Option A (fastest): an acceptance email from an authorized procurement contact to procurement@novamed.com and cc camila.reyes@redwood.com with the sentence: "Novamed accepts the 75,000 token demo sponsorship from Redwood; please apply immediately." We will apply credit within 2 business hours of that email.

Option B (DocuSign): sign the short DocuSign I attached (link below) — takes slightly longer but provides procurement a document to attach to their PO.

Attachment: redwood-voucher-RED-7832.pdf (pdf, 8KB)
Link: https://www.docusign.com/doc/XYZ-RED-7832

Invoice line for when procurement re-opens: "Demo Sponsorship — Dec 2027"
Billing contact: accounts-payable@redwood.com

Let me know which option works and I’ll stand by to activate.

— Camila
